To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

gossip algorithms can be used to solve a wide variety of problems in sensor networks and other ad-hoc networks; and that the mixing time and the convergence time for the gossip algorithm are closely related.

the performance of the gossip algorithms depends on the spectral structure of the doubly stochastic matrix characterising the gossip algorithm, and that the spectral structure of this matrix is in turn related to the mixing time for random walks on the network.

gossip algorithms have the same convergence rate as random walks on a network and that the convergence rate of gossip algorithms depends on the second eigenvalue of a matrix characterizing the gossip algorithm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
designing and analyzing gossip algorithms that solve the averaging problem in a distributed and energy efficient manner.
the development of gossip algorithms, their distributed analysis, and their applications to wireless sensor and ad hoc networks.
the design and analysis of algorithms for computation and information dissemination in arbitrarily connected networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to characterize the convergence time of gossip algorithms in arbitrary networks, design the fastest gossip algorithms, and analyze them on two popular network topologies.

the gossip algorithm is the fastest algorithm for averaging on arbitrary networks, and the mixing time of the corresponding random walk on the network is the best measure to predict the performance of the algorithm.
the gossiping process in a network is a powerful tool to solve a wide range of distributed problems in a decentralized manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gossip algorithms are simple, yet surprisingly effective, for information exchange and computation in large scale networks.
gossip algorithms are simple and effective distributed algorithms that are well suited for networks with limited computational and communication capabilities.
gossip algorithms provide a simple and elegant solution to the distributed computation problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in general, gossip algorithms are fast and efficient.
gossip algorithms are simple, distributed and robust, and can be used to efficiently solve many distributed computing problems.
gossip algorithms can be analyzed using tools from random matrix theory and optimization.
